headline: The U.S.-Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
context: The Trump administration announced a deal Friday to develop a vast amount of Venezuela's oil reserves, with the U.S. taking a majority stake. Energy experts say there are many reasons to be skeptical.
